web_search.promptSnippet: Search the web for current or uncertain information
promptGuidelines: Search when the task needs current information or verification. Use dates and domain filters when relevant, and prefer primary sources.
Link supporting sources near the claims they support. Distinguish search snippets from pages you have read.
If search is unavailable, explain the limitation and continue independent work. Never imply a search succeeded when it did not.
Fetch relevant pages when their contents are needed to answer accurately. Link sources near the claims they support.
Large results may be truncated; consult the reported spill file when the missing content matters.
